label: Teleonomy filter reproduces fine-report screening in the same sampling rows
paraphrase: For any pair of normalized three-cell sampling rows with no other-observer mass in either row, applying the teleonomy fixture's retention filter to the fine indicator yields the same fine-report likelihood as conditioning on observers in each row. Both likelihoods are one. The observer-conditioned report has zero mutual information about the model label for every interior comparison prior.
